label: Finding-48
title: rce-fpm: Status 'disputed' understates a claim the PHP advisory record carries; the dispute is about which CVE, not whether
description: GHSA-6wmf and openwall 2026/10/21/7 (PHP security team, CVE-2026-109619) both say unauthenticated RCE was demonstrated against PHP-FPM. Only the attribution to CVE-2026-109618 is in doubt. Suggest rewording to 'RCE is confirmed on PHP-FPM for CVE-2026-109619 (session upload progress path, needs a suitable application operation); for CVE-2026-109618 the advisory says no complete FPM exploit' and setting the status accordingly. Also cite openwall-oss-security-2026-10-21-7, which is in the manifest but not on this claim; the cited openwall 21/6 is the 109618 post and does not carry the claim.
